about_the_game:
Where Are You, Diamond?

The pursuit of riches is never without risk, and in Where Are You, Diamond?, danger is just as valuable as the prize itself. The legend speaks of a rare and powerful diamond hidden deep within an uncharted land, but no one who has sought it has ever returned. Now, a fearless adventurer steps forward, determined to uncover the truth and claim the treasure.

But this is no ordinary journey. Treacherous terrain, ancient traps, and relentless enemies stand between you and the prize. Armed with only a sword and unwavering determination, you must fight your way through dangerous foes, unlock secrets, and endure harsh conditions. Every step forward is a gamble—how far are you willing to go for ultimate wealth?

Survival is uncertain, but quitting is not an option. With each battle fought and every obstacle overcome, you get one step closer to the diamond. Will you conquer the perils ahead, or will your adventure end in ruin like so many before you? The choice is yours.

Game Features:

🔥 10 thrilling levels – Each level brings new dangers, puzzles, and hidden secrets.
⚔️ 4 unique playable characters – Choose your hero and master their strengths.
💎 Hidden diamonds – Find and collect them to prove your worth.
🗡️ Intense combat – Face off against enemies that will test your skills and strategy.
🌎 Mysterious world – Explore an atmospheric setting filled with danger and adventure.

The treasure is real. The danger is undeniable. The question is—are you brave enough to claim what’s yours?
